##This model should be run 
#Running linear regression only for the proteins (outcome are archetype and exposure : protein and covariates: adjust for age and sex)
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft[, c("u3talteru", "u3csex")]
archetype_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft[, c("Archetypes 1", "Archetypes 2", "Archetypes 3", "Archetypes 4")]
protein_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft[, 35:876]
results_list_prot <- list()
for (prot in colnames(protein_vars)) {
  prot_results <- list()
  
  for (archetype in colnames(archetype_vars)) {
    # Build the formula: archetype ~ protein + clinical covariates
    # Use backticks to handle spaces/special characters in column names
    formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ `", prot, "` + u3talteru + u3csex")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)
    
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # Ensure the protein is present in the coefficient table
    if (paste0("`", prot, "`") %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- paste0("`", prot, "`")
    } else if (prot %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- prot
    } else {
      coef_name <- NA
    }
    
    if (!is.na(coef_name)) {
      estimate <- coefs[coef_name, "Estimate"]
      se <- coefs[coef_name, "Std. Error"]
      p_value <- coefs[coef_name, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ci_lower <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 1]
      ci_upper <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 2]
    } else {
      estimate <- NA
      se <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    }
    
    prot_results[[archetype]] <- data.frame(
      Protein = prot,
      Archetype = archetype,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  results_list_prot[[prot]] <- do.call(rbind, prot_results)
}
final_results_prot <- do.call(rbind, results_list_prot)
final_results_prot$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results_prot$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results_prot, paste0("Proteins_Archetype_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results <- final_results_prot[final_results_prot$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results[order(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value), ])

range(significant_results$Estimate)
```
#filtering signifciant results based on the estimate
```{r}
significant_results_filtered <- significant_results[
  abs(significant_results$Estimate) > 0.1, ]
significant_results_filtered
```

#do not run##
##Run the model for the archetype ~ clinical variables (important for analysis)
```{r}
# Define clinical and archetype variables
clinical_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[3:30]
archetype_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[31:34]

results_list <- list()

# Loop through archetypes (outcomes)
for (archetype in archetype_vars) {
  archetype_results <- list()
  
  # Model formula: archetype ~ all clinical variables
  formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ ", paste(sprintf("`%s`", clinical_vars), collapse = " + "))
  
  model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)
  
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
  
  # Extract results for clinical variables only
  for (var in clinical_vars) {
    if (var %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      estimate <- coefs[var, "Estimate"]
      se <- coefs[var, "Std. Error"]
      p_value <- coefs[var, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ci_lower <- conf_intervals[var, 1]
      ci_upper <- conf_intervals[var, 2]
    } else {
      estimate <- NA
      se <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    }
    
    archetype_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
      Archetype = archetype,
      Clinical_Variable = var,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  results_list[[archetype]] <- do.call(rbind, archetype_results)
}

# Combine results
final_results_clinical <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# Adjust p-values
final_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results_clinical$P_value, method = "fdr")

# Save results
write.csv(final_results_clinical, 
          paste0("Clinical_Archetype_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Extract significant results
significant_results_clinical <- final_results_clinical[final_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
significant_results_clinical <- significant_results_clinical[order(significant_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value), ]

# View top results
head(significant_results_clinical)
```




#Linear regression for dependent variable (proteins ~ clinical varibales )
#The most discriminative omics variables were then investigated for associations with the clinical phenotypes
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft[, 3:30]
proteins_merged <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[35:876]
protein_vars <- intersect(top10_proteins$Protein, proteins_merged)
# protein_vars <- proteins_merged

protein_data <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft[, protein_vars]
top_protein_clinic <- cbind(clinical_vars, protein_data)
results_list <- list()

for (prot in colnames(protein_data)) {
  for (clinical in colnames(clinical_vars)) {
    formula_str <- paste0("`", prot, "` ~ `", clinical, "`")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = top_protein_clinic)
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # The predictor's coefficient is always the second row
    estimate <- coefs[2, "Estimate"]
    se <- coefs[2, "Std. Error"]
    p_value <- coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    ci_lower <- conf_intervals[2, 1]
    ci_upper <- conf_intervals[2, 2]
    
    results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Protein = prot,
      Clinical = clinical,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

final_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
final_results$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results, paste0("protein_clinical_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results_protein_clinical <- final_results[final_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results_protein_clinical[order(significant_results_protein_clinical$Adjusted_P_value), ])

```

##Successful code for both clinical and proteins(not included)
```{r}
clinical_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[3:30]
archetype_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[31:34]
protein_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)[35:876]

results_list <- list()

for (prot in protein_vars) {
  
  prot_results <- list()
  for (archetype in archetype_vars) {
    
    # Model formula: archetype ~ protein + all clinical covariates
    formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ `", prot, "` + ", paste(sprintf("`%s`", clinical_vars), collapse=" + "))
    
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.proteomics.Data.soft)
    
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # Extract results for protein and ALL clinical covariates in this model
    for (var in c(prot, clinical_vars)) {
      if (var %in% rownames(coefs)) {
        estimate <- coefs[var, "Estimate"]
        se <- coefs[var, "Std. Error"]
        p_value <- coefs[var, "Pr(>|t|)"]
        ci_lower <- conf_intervals[var, 1]
        ci_upper <- conf_intervals[var, 2]
      } else {
        estimate <- NA
        se <- NA
        p_value <- NA
        ci_lower <- NA
        ci_upper <- NA
      }
      prot_results[[paste(archetype, var, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
        Protein = prot,
        Archetype = archetype,
        Variable = var,
        Estimate = estimate,
        Std_Error = se,
        P_value = p_value,
        CI_Lower = ci_lower,
        CI_Upper = ci_upper,
        R2 = r2,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  results_list[[prot]] <- do.call(rbind, prot_results)
}

final_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

final_results$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results$P_value, method = "fdr")

write.csv(final_results, paste0("Proteins_Archetype_Regression_Results_with_Clinical_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

significant_results <- final_results[final_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]

head(significant_results[order(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value), ])
```

##Volcano plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
significant_results$negLog10P <- -log10(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value)

# Use the regression estimate as effect size (x-axis)
significant_results$effect <- (significant_results$Estimate)


# Label significance
significant_results$significant <- ifelse(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05 & abs(significant_results$effect) >  1  , "Yes", "No")
significant_results$significant <- factor(significant_results$significant, levels = c("No", "Yes"))

# Add Protein labels for significant hits only
significant_results$label <- ifelse(significant_results$significant == "Yes", significant_results$Protein, NA)


# Volcano plot
ggplot(significant_results, aes(x = effect, y = negLog10P, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Archetype Effect on Proteins",
       x = "effect",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       color = "Significant")
```

##Unique protein names(If you are using the protein, should be unique otherwise plot them in shapes)
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)

#Clean protein names ---
significant_results$Protein_Short <- str_extract(
  significant_results$Protein,
  "(?<=\\||__)[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+(?=_HUMAN)"  # Extract text between |/__ and _HUMAN
)
# Keep original name if no match 
significant_results$Protein_Short <- ifelse(
  is.na(significant_results$Protein_Short),
  significant_results$Protein,
  significant_results$Protein_Short
)
significant_results$negLog10P <- -log10(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value)


# Label directionality based on effect size thresholds
significant_results$significant <- "Not"  # Default: Not Significant
significant_results$significant[significant_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05 & significant_results$Estimate > 0.1] <- "Up"
significant_results$significant[significant_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05 & significant_results$Estimate < -0.1] <- "Down"

# Convert to factor with explicit levels
significant_results$direction <- factor(significant_results$significant, 
                                        levels = c("Not", "Up", "Down"))

# Add Protein labels for significant proteins short name hits only
significant_results$label <- ifelse(
  significant_results$significant != "Not",
  significant_results$Protein_Short,
  NA
)

# Volcano plot with directional coloring
p1<- ggplot(significant_results, aes(x = Estimate, y = negLog10P, color = significant, shape = Archetype)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue","grey","red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.2), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +#Adds vertical dashed lines at x = -0.1 and x = 0.2.
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot of Proteins",
       x = "Effect Size",
       y = "-Log10(P-value)",
       color = "significant")

ggsave("volcano__plot.png", p1, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600,bg = "white")
```

##Create top proteins
```{r}
top10_proteins <- significant_results %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted_P_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = case_when(
      str_detect(Protein, "\\|[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=\\|)[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      str_detect(Protein, "__[A-Z0-9]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=__)[A-Z0-9]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      TRUE ~ Protein
    )
  )
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  mutate(Protein_Short_Unique = make.unique(Protein_Short)) %>%
  ungroup()
```


##Heatmap of archetypes
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
heatmap_matrix <- top10_proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short, Archetype, Estimate) %>%  # Explicit dplyr call
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  as.data.frame()


# Set short names as rownames and remove the column
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Protein_Short
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix %>% dplyr::select(-Protein_Short)
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)
heatmap_matrix <- type.convert(heatmap_matrix, as.is = TRUE)
heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix))
color_breaks <- c(-max_abs_value, -max_abs_value/2, 0, max_abs_value/2, max_abs_value)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = color_breaks,
  colors = c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"),
  space = "LAB"
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  matrix = heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Estimate",
  col = col_fun,
  
  # Row settings - names on right
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",  # Changed from "left" to "right"
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  
  # Column settings
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  # Heatmap appearance
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "lightgray",
  
  # Clustering
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Legend settings
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Estimate",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2)
  )
)
draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm")) # Right padding increased to 10mm
ht

# Save as PNG
png("top_proteins_heatmap.png", 
    width = 2000,  # Pixel dimensions
    height = 1500, 
    res = 300)     # 300 DPI for high quality
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm"))
dev.off()
```

##Create a forest plot
```{r}
top_proteins_long <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = str_extract(Protein, "(?<=__)[A-Z0-9]+(?=_HUMAN)")
  )
top_proteins_long <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = ifelse(is.na(Protein_Short), Protein, Protein_Short)
  )
top_proteins_long <- top10_proteins %>%
  group_by(Archetype, Protein_Short, CI_Lower, CI_Upper) %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short_Unique = ifelse(duplicated(Protein_Short), 
                                  paste0(Protein_Short, "_", Archetype), 
                                  Protein_Short)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



# Clean and prepare your data
df_forest <- top_proteins_long %>%
  mutate(
    Protein = factor(Protein_Short, levels = rev(unique(Protein))),  # reverse for better layout
    Archetype = factor(Archetype, levels = unique(Archetype))  # keep consistent order
  )

# Create forest plot
ggplot(df_forest, aes(x = Estimate, y = Protein_Short, color = Archetype)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), height = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_wrap(~ Archetype, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlab("Estimate with 95% CI")

ggsave("forest.plot.png", width = 9, height = length(unique(df_forest$Protein)) * 0.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

##Heatmap with p values (not used)
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(grid)
library(patchwork) # for combining plots

# Prepare heatmap matrix (as before)
heatmap_df <- top10_proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short, Archetype, Estimate, Adjusted_P_value)

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short, Archetype, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Protein_Short
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix %>% dplyr::select(-Protein_Short)
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)
heatmap_matrix <- type.convert(heatmap_matrix, as.is = TRUE)
heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

padj_matrix <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short, Archetype, Adjusted_P_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Adjusted_P_value) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(padj_matrix) <- padj_matrix$Protein_Short
padj_matrix <- padj_matrix %>% dplyr::select(-Protein_Short)
padj_matrix <- as.matrix(padj_matrix)

# Color function for heatmap
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix))
color_breaks <- c(-max_abs_value, -max_abs_value/2, 0, max_abs_value/2, max_abs_value)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = color_breaks,
  colors = c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "white", "salmon", "darkred"),
  space = "LAB"
)

# Significance function
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

# Create heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  matrix = heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Estimate",
  col = col_fun,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "lightgray",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Estimate",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2)
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    pval <- padj_matrix[i, j]
    sig <- get_significance(pval)
    if (sig != "") {
      grid.text(sig, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, col = "black", fontface = "bold"))
    }
  }
)

# Draw the heatmap to a grob for combining with ggplot
ht_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right"))

print(ht)
```

Row (y-axis) labels: theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = ...))

Column (x-axis) labels: theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = ...))

Stars on heatmap tiles: geom_text(size = ...)

Legend text/title: theme(legend.text = element_text(size = ...), legend.title = element_text(size = ...))

Global baseline (affects most text): theme_minimal(base_size = ...)

```{r}
) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "brown",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Effect Size",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "-log10(P)",
    range = c(3, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Phenotypes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_bubble)

# ==============================
# ==============================

combined <- p_heatmap + p_bubble +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(0.32, 0.68))

print(combined)

# ==============================
# ==============================

ggsave(
  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_fixed.png",
  combined,
  width = 18,
  height = length(protein_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_fixed.pdf",
  combined,
  width = 18,
  height = length(protein_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  bg = "white"
)

getwd()
```
